name: swiftride
description: Ride hailing where the customer picks the route and pays per kilometre. Web + installable PWA, Node API, SQLite.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.android:build: npm --prefix client run build:android && npm --prefix client exec cap sync android && cd client/android && gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.android:open: npm --prefix client exec cap open android
